scope: Physical iPhone17 iOS27, fixed synthetic UITextView seeds. Relative completed host edit intervals, not finger-to-first-edit latency.

physical_results.definition_of_word_burst: First completed edit after 0.85s followed by another edit within35ms; multiple individually acknowledged deletes form each guarded word pulse. The physical UI test independently requires a multi-scalar burst before1.25s and stable text after release.

limitations: Actual vibration strength is not established by callback tests.
Host visual font/insets/caret affinity are unavailable to the extension; soft-wrap positioning is approximate.
Hidden paragraph crossing assumes LF. Clipped host windows, hidden CRLF and delayed context can prevent exact native navigation.
Safari inline completion dismissal is not fixed; no reliable public completion identity/dismissal API was found.
